title: B2 Gate Scope Reconciliation, Synthetic Oracle Evidence & Historical-Uncertainty Route Activation Policy

reconciliation.replacement_rule: B2 is claim-scoped: mandatory for historical fidelity and historical-equivalence claims; independently qualifiable scientific claims may only use the strict historical-uncertainty route after documented reasonable B2 acquisition is genuinely exhausted.

current_prep02r_policy_state.reason: The authoritative PREP02R status still records the prepared external institutional request as unsent. No failure or exhaustion is inferred.

class_policy.A: no-B2 scientific route possible only after acquisition closure, closed identity, physical non-interference, B1 causality, coverage and independent review
class_policy.B: no-B2 scientific route possible only with unambiguous local authority, independent causal/oracle cross-checks and strong coverage
class_policy.C: missing state requires independent state-model/theory authority; mass closure alone forbidden
class_policy.D: historical representation equivalence requires B2; B3-to-B4 representation equivalence may reference admitted B3 while inheriting uncertainty
class_policy.E: separate numerical formulation, convergence, precision/discretization and independent numerical review required; smaller residual forbidden as sole authority
class_policy.F: new physics requires separate scientific-model governance; B2 is not authority for new physics

rg02_gate_reconciliation.G6U: bounded acquisition closure scope inside existing G6
